name: Optimism
items_note: Items copied from https://ipip.ori.org/newSingleConstructsKey.htm, 10 November 2026, +keyed items first as the key page lists them.

source.paper: IPIP scale measuring a construct similar to the Life Orientation Test, Revised (Scheier, Carver, & Bridges, 1994), International Personality Item Pool

licence.text: Public domain (IPIP). Permission is granted automatically for any person to use IPIP items for any purpose, commercial or non-commercial.

instructions: Describe yourself as you generally are now, not as you wish to be in the future. Describe yourself as you honestly see yourself, in relation to other people you know of the same sex as you are, and roughly your same age.

scales.name: Optimism
scales.publishedName: Optimism, IPIP scale similar to the Life Orientation Test, Revised

items.text: Just know that I will be a success.
Look at the bright side of life.
Have a dark outlook on the future.
Feel that my life lacks direction.
Am often in a bad mood.

reliabilitySource: Coefficient alpha as given on the single-construct scoring key page, https://ipip.ori.org/newSingleConstructsKey.htm, accessed 10 November 2026. The page gives no sample size.
